question: A solenoid with a steel core and a solenoid with a soft iron core carry the same current. If the current is switched off, the steel core solenoid still attracts iron pins, while the soft iron one drops them. What specific magnetic property difference explains this observation?

options.A: Steel has higher Permeability than soft iron.
options.B: Steel has higher Retentivity than soft iron.
options.C: Steel has lower Coercivity than soft iron.
options.D: Steel has higher Saturation Magnetization than soft iron.
